cases.reply: You’ll need to check your email or text messages for the school’s address, or look it up online. If you’re at a campus, someone there can point you in the right direction.
cases.why: Dogfooding session 1: what the person just said must outrank anything held from before. Scoped after the fact: this case used to also require the reply to name Tacoma, which is recall (A7) rather than non-inheritance. She answered by inventing a location -- a grounding failure, and a real one, but not the fault this matrix measures. The contamination half, that 'Seattle' must not survive the correction, is what is asserted.
